title: San Francisco company offers cleaning service using humanoid robots
snippet: Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley engineering professor with 40 years in the field, told ABC7 he doubts the technology is ready. 'I really think it is too early,' he said. 'I would be very surprised if these could do anything close to a useful job of cleaning a house.'

title: Generative AI Availability, Grades, and Student Satisfaction at a Large University
snippet: This large-scale empirical study of 156,135 students across nearly 88,000 course offerings over a decade tested the 'GenAI substitution hypothesis.' It found no statistically significant differential effect of generative AI availability on final grades or student satisfaction, even in courses highly susceptible to AI use.

title: Ohio State's colleges advance AI Fluency roadmaps for undergraduates
snippet: Ohio State University is advancing its bold AI Fluency initiative, ensuring that every student, beginning with the class of 2029, will graduate fluent in their field of study and the application of AI in that field. The initiative embeds AI across the curriculum, including required general education seminars and workshops.
